app.name: MV AutoML Studio
app.tagline: From any dataset to a validated model, without writing code
app.subtitle: Automatic ETL, model selection, hyperparameter optimisation and statistical analysis, end to end.

overview.title: Overview
overview.lead: Four steps: you bring the data, the platform cleans it, trains the best model for your target variable and hands you the report.
overview.step1_text: Excel or CSV of any size, or a direct query against your SQL server. No row cap.
overview.step2_text: Types, nulls, duplicates, rare categories, dates and target leakage: a plan is proposed step by step and runs only once you approve it.
overview.step3_title: Say what you want to predict
overview.step3_text: Write it in your own words. The platform identifies the target column, detects the problem type and competes the models.
overview.step4_text: Metrics on a blind holdout, per-variable contribution, diagnostics and export to Excel, CSV or Parquet.

data.title: Data
data.lead: Bring the dataset in from a file or from any SQL server.
data.upload_hint: Drop the file here or click to choose it
data.upload_formats: CSV, TXT, TSV, Excel (xlsx, xlsm, xls, ods), Parquet and JSON
data.upload_nolimit: No size limit: the file is processed in blocks and stored columnar. Disk is the limit, not memory.
data.sql_hint: Connect to SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, DuckDB or any engine via a SQLAlchemy URL.
data.query_hint: Read only: SELECT and WITH are accepted.
data.delete_confirm: Remove this dataset from the workspace?
data.read_only_note: The connector is read only: any write statement is rejected.

explore.title: Explore
explore.lead: Full statistical profile computed over the whole dataset, not a sample.
explore.no_correlations: At least two numeric columns are needed.

etl.title: ETL
etl.lead: The plan is derived from the actual profile of the dataset and explained step by step. Nothing runs until you approve it.
etl.sql_note: The plan compiles to a single SQL statement: auditable, reproducible and out of core.
etl.leakage_none: No column was found to contain the answer.
etl.leakage_note: A column that anticipates the target produces unreal metrics that never repeat in production. It is blocked before training, not after.
etl.opt_null_threshold: Null threshold to drop a column (%)

model.title: Modelling
model.lead: Write what you want to predict. The platform identifies the column, detects the problem type and competes the models.
model.objective_label: What do you want to predict?
model.objective_placeholder: For example: whether the customer will pay in the next 30 days
model.objective_hint: Write it in your own words, or pick the target column directly.
model.associations: How each variable relates to the target
model.time_column_hint: If you declare it, validation becomes walk-forward: training on the future to predict the past inflates every metric.
model.metric_auto: automatic, based on the problem type
model.budget_hint: Seconds spent searching hyperparameters. More budget, deeper search.
model.ensemble: Compare the blend against the best single model
model.protocol_text: The data is split three ways: training to fit, selection to choose, and a blind holdout that no decision ever touches. The number reported is the holdout one, because reporting the window used to choose the model always looks better than the model really is.
model.families_hint: With nothing selected, the best available families for the dataset size compete. The catalog is extensible: each family is one file under backend/app/core/zoo.

results.title: Results
results.lead: Everything shown here is measured on the blind holdout.
results.no_model: No model has been trained yet.
results.score_dataset: Apply the model to a dataset

ai.title: AI engine
ai.lead: Pick the provider and the model. AI adds natural-language interpretation; ETL, AutoML and export all work with no key configured.
ai.key_stored: The key is stored on this machine only, with restricted permissions, and is never returned to the browser.
ai.uses_title: What AI is used for here
ai.use1: Translate the objective written in plain language into a dataset column.
ai.use2: Give a second opinion on the ETL plan before it runs.
ai.use3: Write the executive reading of the result in the chosen language.
ai.no_provider: No provider configured. Without AI the platform still runs in full: only the natural-language interpretation is missing.

export.title: Export
export.lead: The Excel report carries the executive summary, model comparison, variable analysis, diagnostics, data quality, statistical analysis and the ETL plan.
export.excel_limit_note: Excel allows up to 1,048,576 rows per sheet. Above that the listing is split across sheets; for large volumes CSV or Parquet are better, they have no cap.
export.no_files: You have not generated any file yet.

errors.generic: Something failed. The detail is below.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check that the process is still running.
errors.upload_failed: The file could not be processed.

audio.title: Audio
audio.test_phrase: Audio operational. Result narration is active.
audio.no_voices: This browser has no voices available for the selected language.
audio.voice_unsupported: This browser does not support voice dictation.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.name: Workspace name
workspace.name_hint: Lowercase, numbers, dash and underscore. Each workspace isolates its datasets, models, connections and files.
workspace.delete_confirm: Delete this workspace with all its datasets and models?
workspace.isolated: Data in one workspace is not visible from another.

dash.ask_hint: With AI configured, the provider translates the question to SQL and writes the answer from the executed result. Without AI, a local translator covers totals, averages, counts, top N and group-bys.
dash.ask_placeholder: For example: total collected by debt bucket in 2025
dash.lead: KPIs, filters and charts inferred automatically from the dataset. Everything you see can be exported with the active filters applied.
dash.no_dataset: Pick a dataset first in the Data section.
dash.title: Dashboard

license.title: License
license.demo_note: You are in Demo mode: up to 50,000 rows per dataset, 3 model families, no SQL connectors or AI engine.
